question: Where are a museum located within a 140 kilometers range toward the west of Cardiovascular Institute of New England, Cranston, RI?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE museum IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 140000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%RI%' LIMIT 1 ), geometry )) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5;
